issue.body: When my app runs behind an IPv6 address and I configure TrustedHostMiddleware with allowed_hosts, requests coming from bracketed IPv6 hosts like [::1]:8000 get rejected with 400 Invalid host header even though the host is in the allowed list. It looks like the middleware does not parse the brackets/port for IPv6 correctly.
issue.title: TrustedHostMiddleware rejects requests from IPv6 hosts
